name: Bellamy
source:
Leader of a pirate group who searches to rid her of a curse.

She’s been searching far and wide for unique booty, adding members to her crew as she goes.

“Sorry, but that doesn’t look like a good time to me.”

From Eiyuu Senki WWX.
